name: Item Creation
title: Item Creation: one general equipment profession
summary: Item Creation is the single profession that creates all equipment families from selected bases and resources. Its skill primarily sets modifier-count probabilities; Luck and Perception add to that probability. Base-specific modifier-type weights stay fixed. Enchanting is a separate profession.
scenarioNote: Отдельный проигранный сценарий в этот импорт не входил.

points.text: Item Creation creates all armour, weapons, jewellery, and accessories; material families do not each have a separate crafting profession.
The skill primarily influences modifier count (0–6); Luck and Perception are additional influences and do not alter base modifier-type weights.
The selected base/stage supplies fixed modifier-type weights and applicable tier tables.
The Vertical Slice still defers deep crafting; this design update does not authorise implementation.

gaps: Exact skill thresholds, modifier-count curve, Luck/Perception coefficients, base catalogue, recipes, costs, and timing remain open.
